_help: Weekly seasonal events the app fills in automatically. weekdays: 0=Mon ... 5=Sat, 6=Sun. months: 1-12. Optional from/until as MM-DD to trim the first/last month. Times are 24-hour local time. Check season dates each spring.

recurring.title: Wenatchee Valley Farmers Market
recurring.desc: Saturday farmers market in the Pybus parking lot, May through December: produce, flowers, artisan goods, food and live music. Late-season dates can change; confirm with the market.

recurring.title: Leavenworth Community Farmers Market
recurring.desc: Saturday community farmers market. Season dates are approximate; confirm with the market.

recurring.title: Chelan Evening Farmers Market
recurring.desc: Thursday afternoon farmers market. Season dates are approximate; confirm with the market.
